journey.name: Core Flow
journey.description: Tests the end-to-end user journey: creating a category, a project, and adding a task.

actions.action: Tap 'View All Categories' on the home screen to navigate to the categories view.
Open the creation menu by tapping the '+' button at the bottom right of the screen.
Type 'Work' in the 'Category Name' text field.
Tap 'Create Category'. This should close the sheet and show 'Work' as the active category title at the top of the screen.
Open the category add menu by tapping the '+' button again.
Type 'Launch Website' in the 'Project Name' field.
Tap 'Create'. This should return you to the category list where the 'Launch Website' project card is now visible.
Tap on the 'Launch Website' card to open the project details.
Open the project action menu by tapping the '+' button.
Select 'Add Task' to open the task input dialog.
Type 'Buy domain' in the task description field and tap 'Add'.
Verify that 'Buy domain' appears in the checklist section of the project.
